_rules: One entry = one Flow ingredient (a reference image). Master image lives in flow/library/images/<id>.png; the repo is the source of truth, Flow is a copy.
id prefix: STY = look, CHR = character, SET = place/set, OBJ = prop. flow_name is what the ingredient is called inside Flow.
scope 'global' = every city uses it (upload to every Flow project). scope '<slug>' = only that city.
Flow allows at most 3 ingredients per generation. Packs always attach STY-clay first, then up to 2 matches (CHR before SET before OBJ).
match = lowercase phrases; if a scene prompt contains one, the ingredient is attached. A scene can override with "ingredients": [ids] in the storyboard.
Historical figures are generic era figures, never a real likeness. Names go on screen in the edit, not in the image.

ingredients.create_prompt: Claymation stop-motion style, handcrafted plasticine miniature diorama, warm clay textures with visible fingerprints and tool marks, soft warm studio lighting with gentle shadows, shallow depth of field, tilt-shift miniature feel, matte surfaces, muted earthy palette of terracotta, ochre, sandstone, indigo and leaf green, a small Indian clay town street with sandstone houses, a well, a banyan tree and two clay villagers, golden afternoon light, wide shot, cinematic 16:9 composition, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos
ingredients.notes: The look anchor. Pick the candidate whose clay texture and palette you like most; every shot is matched to it.

ingredients.create_prompt: Claymation stop-motion character sheet on a plain warm-grey background, three panels side by side: (1) bust-up front view, (2) full body front view, (3) full body rear view, same character in all three. Face: warm brown clay skin with soft fingerprint texture, deep smile lines, kind narrow eyes behind round thin brass-rimmed spectacles, thick white eyebrows. Hair: white, receding, short at the sides, full white beard trimmed to chest length. Outfit: off-white cotton kurta to the knees, plain white dhoti, a saffron-brown wool shawl draped over both shoulders with a thin maroon border, brown leather jootis, a rolled parchment scroll held in the right hand. Soft even studio light, matte plasticine, handcrafted miniature feel, no text, no letters, no watermark
ingredients.notes: Build with the character-consistency skill: generate, pick one, keep the same seed/candidate for every city. Appears in hook and outro only.
